title: Will Neymar play tonight for Santos vs Coritiba in Brasileiro Série A 2026?
text:
Will Neymar play tonight for Santos vs Coritiba in Brasileiro Série A 2026? Home Sports Asian Games Live Score More Advertisement World Football 
 Will Neymar play tonight for Santos vs Coritiba in Brasileiro Série A 2026?
 By Rajarshi Shukla Follow Add as Preferred Source Rajarshi has been part of Khel Now since 2022, and he covers world football. Published at : November 18, 2026 at 7:25 PM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : November 18, 2026 at 7:25 PM (GMT+5:30) (Courtesy :  Getty Images )
 The forward is available after his suspension. 
 Coritiba will host Neymar’s Santos at the Estadio Major Antônio Couto Pereira in an attempt to climb further up the table in Brasileiro Série A.
 With 42 points from 34 games, the hosts are five points clear of the relegation zone in 13th place in the standings. Meanwhile, the visitors are in ninth place with 47 points and are looking to bolster their chances of qualifying for the Copa Libertadores the following season.
 After defeating Vitoria 2-0 at home, Coritiba’s most recent league match ended in a 1-0 away loss to Internacional, which prevented them from winning back-to-back games.
 Santos , on the other hand, came to Coritiba hoping to snap a three-game losing streak in the league after drawing with Bahia and Palmeiras and losing 2-1 on the road to Red Bull Bragantino.
 With a 2-1 victory over Fluminense , the Peixe had momentarily improved their standing. However, they have since struggled to turn promising performances into victories, winning just one of their last six league games (D3, L2). As a result, they are now six points behind sixth-place Bahia and have ground to make up in the race for continental qualification.
 Gabriel Barbosa, who scored 15 goals in the 2026 Campeonato Brasileiro, is anticipated to spearhead the assault. Meanwhile, Neymar is once again eligible following the reduction of his suspension.
 Will Neymar play tonight against Coritiba?
 Catch Every Update, Anytime, Anywhere
 Neymar Jr of Santos (Courtesy: Getty) 
 Neymar is anticipated to play for Santos FC against Coritiba in tonight’s Brasileirão Sánchez A match.
 After receiving a red card against Bahia, Neymar missed Santos’ prior games. However, Santos’ appeal was accepted by Brazil ‘s Superior Court of Sporting Justice (STJD), allowing him to return for matchday 35.
 Under manager Cuca, he is expected to start alongside Philippe Coutinho and Gabriel Barbosa (Gabigol) after travelling to Coritiba with the team.
 Will Neymar play tonight?
 Yes, he is available for tonight’s game.
 What time will the game start? 
 It will start at 4 am IST on 19 November.
